statement:
All of these hold:
  - when the verbalizer fails on the formula of a unit with a fault of its own, checker does not say why the formula of the unit cannot be said
  - for every run, every command_1 and every unit:
      when all of these hold:
        - the run asks for command_1
        - command_1 is the command `generate` or is the command `check`
        - the verbalizer fails on the formula of the unit with a fault of its own
      then the run does not exit with code 0.
formula: (all u: Unit | u in Faulted implies u not in Explained) and (all r: Run, c: Command, u: Unit | (r->c in Ask.rel and (c in GenerateCommand or c in CheckCommand) and u in Faulted) implies r not in Exits0)
answer: (all u: Unit | u in Faulted implies u not in Explained) and (all r: Run, c: Command, u: Unit | (r->c in Ask.rel and (c = GenerateCommand or c = CheckCommand) and u in Faulted) implies r not in Exits0)

statement:
For every plugin, every document and every listing frontmatter:
  when the document starts with the listing frontmatter and the listing frontmatter lists the plugin, checker runs the plugin over the document.
formula: all p: Plugin, d: Document, f: Listing | (d->f in Head.rel and lists[f, p]) implies p->d in Over.rel
answer: all p: Plugin, d: Document, f: Listing | (d->f in Head.rel and lists[f, p]) implies p->d in Over.rel

statement: When project has a tracker and a bug names no issue, checker reports an untracking for the bug.
formula: all b: Bug | (some Tracker and (no i: Issue | b->i in Name.issue)) implies b in Untracking
answer: all b: Bug | (some Tracker and (no i: Issue | b->i in Name.issue)) implies b in Untracking

statement:
For every document_1, every document_2, every unit_1, every unit_2 and every word:
  when all of these hold:
    - document_2 is context for document_1
    - document_1 holds unit_1
    - a reading in unit_1 says the word
    - document_2 holds unit_2
    - unit_2 declares the word
  then the word is said by no reading or is declared.
formula: all d: Document, e: Document, u: Unit, v: Unit, w: Word | (d->e in Context.rel and d->u in Hold.units and u->w in Voice.rel and e->v in Hold.units and v->w in Introduce.rel) implies w not in Undeclared
answer: all d1, d2: Document, u1, u2: Unit, w: Word | (d1->d2 in Context.rel and d1->u1 in Hold.units and u1->w in Voice.rel and d2->u2 in Hold.units and u2->w in Introduce.rel) implies w not in Undeclared

statement:
When all of these hold:
  - a unit holds a formula
  - the unit has no statement
  - the formula of the unit can be said in words
then the statement of the unit is unwritten.
formula: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Stated and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Unwritten
answer: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Stated and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Unwritten

statement: When a definition has an alternative that says something about another unit, verbalizer says the definition as a list of the alternatives as they stand.
formula: all f: Definition | f in NotAboutSubject implies f in AsItStands
answer: all d: Definition | d in NotAboutSubject implies d in AsItStands

statement:
When all of these hold:
  - a unit holds a formula
  - the unit is not a term
  - no other formula can contradict the formula of the unit
then checker reports the formula of the unit as lone on a signature.
formula: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Term and u in Unchallenged) implies (some w: Signature | u->w in Expose.rel)
answer: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Term and u in Unchallenged) implies (some s: Signature | u->s in Expose.rel)

statement:
For every plugin, every document and every listing frontmatter:
  when all of these hold:
    - the document starts with the listing frontmatter
    - the listing frontmatter holds no entry
    - the command line of no run names the document
  then checker does not run the plugin over the document.
formula: all p: Plugin, d: Document, f: Listing | (d->f in Head.rel and (no e: Entry | f->e in Item.rel) and d not in Given) implies p->d not in Over.rel
answer: all p: Plugin, d: Document, f: Listing | (d->f in Head.rel and (no e: Entry | f->e in Item.rel) and d not in Given) implies p->d not in Over.rel

statement:
For every fence and every unit:
  when the fence names a language and lies in the own text of the unit, checker reads the fence as a block of the unit.
formula: all f: Fence, u: Unit | (f in Languaged and f->u in Within.rel) implies u->f in Blocks.rel
answer: all f: Fence, u: Unit | (f in Languaged and f->u in Within.rel) implies u->f in Blocks.rel

statement:
For every document, every unit and every word:
  when the document keeps no readings and holds the unit, checker does not report the formula of the unit as lone on the word.
formula: all d: Document, u: Unit, w: Word | (d not in Worded and d->u in Hold.units) implies u->w not in Expose.rel
answer: all d: Document, u: Unit, w: Word | (d not in Worded and d->u in Hold.units) implies u->w not in Expose.rel

statement: When the statement of a unit is current, checker does not write the statement of the unit when it generates.
formula: all u: Unit | u in Current implies u not in Rewritten
answer: all u: Unit | u in Current implies u not in Rewritten

statement:
For every run and every command_1:
  when the run asks for command_1 and command_1 is not available, checker reports command_1 as an unknown command.
formula: all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies c in Unknown
answer: all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies c in Unknown

statement:
When at least one of these holds:
  - a frontmatter has the flaw of an entry that starts with an at sign outside quotes
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of a key that neither the checker nor a plugin that the frontmatter lists defines
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of a list that is not closed
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of a string that is not closed
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of a key that appears twice
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of a path that names no document
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of an extension that leads back to its own document
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of a setting in a document that is not the entry document
then the checker cannot read the frontmatter.
formula: all f: Frontmatter | (f in Misquoted or f in Foreign or f in Unclosed or f in Unterminated or f in Doubled or f in Dangling or f in Looping or f in Stray) implies f in Refused
answer: all f: Frontmatter | (f in Misquoted or f in Foreign or f in Unclosed or f in Unterminated or f in Doubled or f in Dangling or f in Looping or f in Stray) implies f in Refused

statement:
For every document and every unit:
  when all of these hold:
    - the document keeps readings
    - the document holds the unit
    - the unit holds a formula
    - the statement of the unit is not current
  then checker reports the statement of the unit.
formula: all d: Document, u: Unit | (d in Worded and d->u in Hold.units and u in Logical and u not in Current) implies u in Reported
answer: all d: Document, u: Unit | (d in Worded and d->u in Hold.units and u in Logical and u not in Current) implies u in Reported

statement:
For every pass_1 and every pass_2:
  when all of these hold:
    - pass_1 says a quantifier as a noun phrase
    - pass_2 says a quantifier of its variable alone as "there is a … that"
  then pass_1 runs before pass_2.
formula: all a: NounPhrases, b: ThereIsAThat | a->b in ahead
answer: all p1, p2: Pass | (p1 in NounPhrases and p2 in ThereIsAThat) implies p2 in p1.ahead

statement:
For every run and every logic command:
  when all of these hold:
    - the run asks for the logic command
    - at least one of these holds:
        - there is a scenario such that checker reports that the scenario cannot happen
        - there is a unit that is held with units that cannot all hold
  then the run does not exit with code 0.
formula: all r: Run, c: LogicCommand | (r->c in Ask.rel and ((some x: Scenario | x in Raised) or (some u: Unit | u in Contradicting))) implies r not in Exits0
answer: all r: Run, c: LogicCommand | (r->c in Ask.rel and ((some s: Scenario | s in Raised) or (some u: Unit | u in Contradicting))) implies r not in Exits0

statement:
For every scenario and every unit:
  when all of these hold:
    - checker reports that the scenario cannot happen
    - leaving out the unit lets the scenario happen
  then checker names the unit in its report of the scenario.
formula: all c: Scenario, u: Unit | (c in Raised and u->c in Frees.rel) implies c->u in Blame.rel
answer: all s: Scenario, u: Unit | (s in Raised and u->s in Frees.rel) implies s->u in Blame.rel

statement:
For every unit_1 and every unit_2:
  when all of these hold:
    - unit_1 is held with units that cannot all hold
    - the analyzer is asked about unit_1 together with unit_2
  then checker names unit_2 in its report of a contradiction.
formula: all u: Unit, v: Unit | (u in Contradicting and u->v in Together.rel) implies v in Named
answer: all u1, u2: Unit | (u1 in Contradicting and u1->u2 in Together.rel) implies u2 in Named

statement:
For every run:
  all of these hold:
    - when the run gets code 2 from a plugin, the run exits with code 2
    - when all of these hold:
        - the run gets code 1 from a plugin
        - the run gets code 2 from no plugin
        - checker does not stop the run itself
      then the run exits with code 1.
formula: all r: Run | ((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) implies r in Exits2) and (((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1) and (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) and not stopped[r]) implies r in Exits1)
answer: all r: Run | ((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) implies r in Exits2) and (((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1) and (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) and not stopped[r]) implies r in Exits1)

statement:
For every document_1, every document_2, every unit_1, every unit_2 and every word:
  when all of these hold:
    - document_2 is context for document_1
    - document_1 holds unit_1
    - document_2 holds unit_2
    - a block of unit_2 names the word outside its declaration
  then checker does not report the formula of unit_1 as lone on the word.
formula: all d: Document, e: Document, u: Unit, v: Unit, w: Word | (d->e in Context.rel and d->u in Hold.units and e->v in Hold.units and v->w in Utter.rel) implies u->w not in Expose.rel
answer: all d1, d2: Document, u1, u2: Unit, w: Word | (d1->d2 in Context.rel and d1->u1 in Hold.units and d2->u2 in Hold.units and u2->w in Utter.rel) implies u1->w not in Expose.rel

statement:
All of these hold:
  - when all of these hold:
      - a unit holds a formula
      - the unit is not a term
      - no other formula can contradict the formula of the unit
    then checker reports the formula of the unit as lone on a signature
  - for every unit and every word:
      when checker reports the formula of the unit as lone on the word, no other formula can contradict the formula of the unit.
formula: (all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Term and u in Unchallenged) implies (some w: Signature | u->w in Expose.rel)) and (all u: Unit, w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel implies u in Unchallenged)
answer: (all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Term and u in Unchallenged) implies (some s: Signature | u->s in Expose.rel)) and (all u: Unit, w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel implies u in Unchallenged)

statement:
For every pass_1 and every pass_2:
  when all of these hold:
    - pass_1 says a set equal to a variable as that variable and no other
    - pass_2 makes nested quantifiers of "for every" one
  then pass_1 runs before pass_2.
formula: all a: XAndNoOther, b: ForEveryTogether | a->b in ahead
answer: all p1, p2: Pass | (p1 in XAndNoOther and p2 in ForEveryTogether) implies p2 in p1.ahead

statement:
When all of these hold:
  - there is a unit_1 such that a reading in unit_1 says a word
  - no unit declares the word
then the word is said by a reading and declared by nothing.
formula: all w: Word | ((some u: Unit | u->w in Voice.rel) and (no u: Unit | u->w in Introduce.rel)) implies w in Undeclared
answer: all w: Word | ((some u1: Unit | u1->w in Voice.rel) and (no u: Unit | u->w in Introduce.rel)) implies w in Undeclared

statement:
When all of these hold:
  - a list is a rule whose first side is a run of clauses said as bullets
  - the list is a rule whose second side is one line with no time phrase, relative clause, comma or "when"
  - the list is not a rule with an "otherwise"
then verbalizer says the second side of the list before its first side.
formula: all f: Series | (f in ListFirstSide and f in PlainSecondSide and f not in Otherwise) implies f in SecondSideFirst
answer: all l: Series | (l in ListFirstSide and l in PlainSecondSide and l not in Otherwise) implies l in SecondSideFirst

statement:
When at least one of these holds:
  - there is a frontmatter that lists a missing plugin
  - there is a document such that checker reports that the document has a frontmatter it cannot read
  - a run asks for a command that is not available
  - the run gets code 2 from a plugin
then the run exits with code 2.
formula: all r: Run | ((some f: Frontmatter, p: Missing | lists[f, p]) or (some d: Document | d in Unreadable) or (some c: Command | r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) or (some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2)) implies r in Exits2
answer: all r: Run | ((some f: Frontmatter, p: Missing | lists[f, p]) or (some d: Document | d in Unreadable) or (some c: Command | r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) or (some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2)) implies r in Exits2
doubt: The first two conditions are not tied to the run; read as run-independent conditions.

statement:
When all of these hold:
  - a run gets code 1 from a plugin
  - the run gets code 2 from no plugin
  - checker does not stop the run itself
then the run exits with code 1.
formula: all r: Run | ((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1) and (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) and not stopped[r]) implies r in Exits1
answer: all r: Run | ((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1) and (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) and not stopped[r]) implies r in Exits1

statement:
When a search leaves one unit out
then there is exactly one unit_1 such that all of these hold:
       - the search leaves out unit_1
       - the analyzer is asked to hold the formula of unit_1
       - the search does not require unit_1 to hold
       - for every unit_2:
           when all of these hold:
             - the analyzer is asked to hold the formula of unit_2
             - unit_2 and unit_1 are different
           then the search requires unit_2 to hold.
formula: all s: Search | s in Trial implies (one u: Unit | s->u in Leave.rel and u in Held and s->u not in Pose.units and (all v: Unit | (v in Held and v != u) implies s->v in Pose.units))
answer: all s: Trial | one u1: Unit | s->u1 in Leave.rel and u1 in Held and s->u1 not in Pose.units and (all u2: Unit | (u2 in Held and u2 != u1) implies s->u2 in Pose.units)

statement:
For every document and every unit:
  when all of these hold:
    - the document keeps readings
    - the document holds the unit
    - the unit holds a formula
    - the statement of the unit is not current
  then checker reports the statement of the unit.
formula: all d: Document, u: Unit | (d in Worded and d->u in Hold.units and u in Logical and u not in Current) implies u in Reported
answer: all d: Document, u: Unit | (d in Worded and d->u in Hold.units and u in Logical and u not in Current) implies u in Reported

statement:
When all of these hold:
  - a list is a rule whose two sides are each one clause
  - the list is not a rule whose first side begins with a time phrase
  - the list is not a rule whose second side begins with a time phrase
then verbalizer says the list without "then".
formula: all f: Series | (f in OneLineRule and f not in TimeFirst and f not in TimeSecond) implies f in DropsThen
answer: all l: Series | (l in OneLineRule and l not in TimeFirst and l not in TimeSecond) implies l in DropsThen

statement:
For every pass_1 and every pass_2:
  when pass_1 says a few clauses as one sentence and pass_2 says the second side of a rule before its first side, pass_1 runs before pass_2.
formula: all a: ClausesInASentence, b: ClaimFirst | a->b in ahead
answer: all p1, p2: Pass | (p1 in ClausesInASentence and p2 in ClaimFirst) implies p2 in p1.ahead

statement:
For every unit_1 and every word:
  when all of these hold:
    - a reading in unit_1 says the word
    - a unit declares the word
    - unit_1 does not declare the word
  then the reading of the word is in another unit than its declaration.
formula: all u: Unit, w: Word | (u->w in Voice.rel and (some v: Unit | v->w in Introduce.rel) and u->w not in Introduce.rel) implies w in Apart
answer: all u1: Unit, w: Word | (u1->w in Voice.rel and (some u: Unit | u->w in Introduce.rel) and u1->w not in Introduce.rel) implies w in Apart

statement:
For every run and every logic command:
  when all of these hold:
    - the run asks for the logic command
    - there is no scenario such that checker reports that the scenario cannot happen
    - no unit is held with units that cannot all hold
  then the run exits with code 0.
formula: all r: Run, c: LogicCommand | (r->c in Ask.rel and (no x: Scenario | x in Raised) and (no u: Unit | u in Contradicting)) implies r in Exits0
answer: all r: Run, c: LogicCommand | (r->c in Ask.rel and (no s: Scenario | s in Raised) and (no u: Unit | u in Contradicting)) implies r in Exits0

statement:
For every pass_1 and every pass_2:
  when all of these hold:
    - pass_1 says a few clauses as one sentence
    - pass_2 says the subject and the verb that negative clauses share once, before "none of these"
  then pass_1 runs before pass_2.
formula: all a: ClausesInASentence, b: NoneOfThese | a->b in ahead
answer: all p1, p2: Pass | (p1 in ClausesInASentence and p2 in NoneOfThese) implies p2 in p1.ahead

statement:
For every search, every scenario and every unit_1:
  when all of these hold:
    - the search leaves one unit out
    - the search requires the scenario to happen
    - the search leaves out unit_1
    - there is a unit_2 such that the author asks about leaving out unit_2 for the scenario
  then the author asks about leaving out unit_1 for the scenario.
formula: all s: Search, c: Scenario, u: Unit | (s in Trial and s->c in Pose.scenario and s->u in Leave.rel and (some v: Unit | c->v in Probe.rel)) implies c->u in Probe.rel
answer: all s: Search, sc: Scenario, u1: Unit | (s in Trial and s->sc in Pose.scenario and s->u1 in Leave.rel and (some u2: Unit | sc->u2 in Probe.rel)) implies sc->u1 in Probe.rel

statement:
When all of these hold:
  - a list has an item that holds a comma
  - the list has more than two clauses
then verbalizer says the list as bullets.
formula: all f: Series | (f in CommaItem and f in MoreThanTwo) implies f in AsBullets
answer: all l: Series | (l in CommaItem and l in MoreThanTwo) implies l in AsBullets

statement:
For every document_1, every document_2 and every unit:
  when all of these hold:
    - the project lists document_1 among the documents it checks
    - document_2 is context for document_1
    - document_2 holds the unit
    - the unit holds a formula with no keyword
  then the analyzer is asked to hold the formula of the unit.
formula: all d: Document, e: Document, u: Unit | (d in Checked and d->e in Context.rel and e->u in Hold.units and u in BareFormula) implies u in Held
answer: all d1, d2: Document, u: Unit | (d1 in Checked and d1->d2 in Context.rel and d2->u in Hold.units and u in Logical and u in BareFormula) implies u in Held

statement:
When all of these hold:
  - a unit is not used
  - the unit is not a conflict
  - the unit is not a thread
then checker reports an orphaning for the unit.
formula: all u: Unit | (not used[u] and u not in Conflict and u not in Thread) implies u in Orphaning
answer: all u: Unit | (not used[u] and u not in Conflict and u not in Thread) implies u in Orphaning
